aiuc1_requirement_summary: Customer-facing policy on input data use for training and inference, retention, and data rights
notes: AI RMF expects documented data policies but does not require customer-facing disclosure of training use or retention terms.

aiuc1_requirement_summary: Customer-facing policy on AI output ownership, use, opt-out, and deletion
notes: Official crosswalk maps no AI RMF subcategory. AI RMF covers policy and transparency generally but says nothing specific about output ownership.

aiuc1_requirement_summary: Limit agent data access to task-relevant data by user role, agent role, and context
notes: AI RMF supports defining tasks and roles but does not require runtime access scoping for agents.

aiuc1_requirement_summary: Prevent AI systems from leaking the organization's own IP and confidential information
notes: Official crosswalk maps no AI RMF subcategory. AI RMF focuses mainly on harm to others, so confidentiality of the organization's own IP is only indirectly covered.

aiuc1_requirement_summary: Prevent cross-customer data exposure through consent, tenant isolation, and privacy-enhancing techniques
notes: AI RMF addresses privacy risk but not multi-tenant isolation at the agent level.

aiuc1_requirement_summary: Keep personal data out of AI outputs and logs
notes: AI RMF calls for examining privacy risk and monitoring production behavior but does not require output filtering or log redaction.

aiuc1_requirement_summary: Prevent outputs from infringing third-party copyrights, trademarks, or other IP
notes: AI RMF explicitly names IP infringement risk but does not require technical safeguards on outputs.
